The stops in between: Segment QÑ-HH-051 - Inca Misana, Huascarán National Park, Segment Tambillo - Pincosh and Segment Taparaku - Tambo de Llata. The highest point is about 4,300 m. The line favours views over speed.

places-abrigo-del-pozo-iii-abrigo-del-mo.story: A 256 km round trip from Calasparra - roughly 4 h 25 in the saddle. On the way it passes Abrigo de la Ventana I, Abrigo del mojao and back through Abrigo de la Ventana I. The highest point is about 1,300 m. The line favours views over speed.
